suggestions.name: Garchomp
suggestions.ability_reason: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.

suggestions.name: Shuckle
suggestions.ability_reason: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.
suggestions.rationale: Shuckle has modest offenses; lean into its bulk (HP 20, defense 230) with a Bold spread as a wall.

suggestions.name: Mega Metagross
suggestions.ability_reason: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.
suggestions.rationale: Mega Metagross pairs strong Speed (base 110) with Attack (base 145); a max-Speed max-Attack spread and a Jolly nature make it a fast attacker.

suggestions.name: Slaking
suggestions.ability_reason: Each time the Pokémon uses a move, it spends the next turn loafing around.
suggestions.rationale: Slaking pairs strong Speed (base 100) with Attack (base 160); a max-Speed max-Attack spread and a Jolly nature make it a fast attacker.

suggestions.name: Pikachu
suggestions.ability_reason: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.
suggestions.rationale: Pikachu pairs strong Speed (base 90) with Attack (base 55); a max-Speed max-Attack spread and a Jolly nature make it a fast attacker.

suggestions.name: Mega Blastoise
suggestions.ability_reason: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
suggestions.rationale: Mega Blastoise hits hard (base Sp. Atk 135) but is slow (base Speed 78); invest in bulk + Sp. Atk with a Modest nature as a wallbreaker.

suggestions.name: Tyranitar
suggestions.ability_reason: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.
suggestions.rationale: Tyranitar hits hard (base Attack 134) but is slow (base Speed 61); invest in bulk + Attack with a Adamant nature as a wallbreaker.

suggestions.name: Salamence
suggestions.ability_reason: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.
suggestions.rationale: Salamence pairs strong Speed (base 100) with Attack (base 135); a max-Speed max-Attack spread and a Jolly nature make it a fast attacker.

suggestions.name: Scizor
suggestions.ability_reason: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
suggestions.rationale: Scizor hits hard (base Attack 130) but is slow (base Speed 65); invest in bulk + Attack with a Adamant nature as a wallbreaker.

suggestions.name: Mew
suggestions.ability_reason: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.
suggestions.rationale: Mew pairs strong Speed (base 100) with Attack (base 100); a max-Speed max-Attack spread and a Jolly nature make it a fast attacker.

suggestions.name: Chandelure
suggestions.ability_reason: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.
suggestions.rationale: Chandelure pairs strong Speed (base 80) with Sp. Atk (base 145); a max-Speed max-Sp. Atk spread and a Timid nature make it a fast attacker.

suggestions.name: Feraligatr
suggestions.ability_reason: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.
suggestions.rationale: Feraligatr hits hard (base Attack 105) but is slow (base Speed 78); invest in bulk + Attack with a Adamant nature as a wallbreaker.
